title: •Luke’s Hunting Rifle
caption: •Luke’s Hunting Rifle (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to deploy on Crell, Luke (of ability < 5), or Owen Lars. May target a character or creature using 1 Force. Draw destiny. If destiny + X > defense value, target’s power = 0 (lost if a creature), where X = the number of your devices at same and related locations.
lore: Czerka 6-2Aug2. Extended barrel provides long-range targeting without expensive laser sight. Sturdy construction, but no match for a Tusken Raider’s gaderffii stick.

notes: Sheet group: Farming. Unique. Green weapon frame, banner CHARACTER WEAPON. Curly apostrophes Luke’s (title/caption) and target’s. No inline icons, no column icons. Slip text matches the stub. LORE corrected from the 745 scan and the V7 remake: curly apostrophe Raider’s (wiki straight). Copyright 1996 legible.
